views.name: city_quarter_totals
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_city AS city,
  t.calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter_label,
  t.calendar_year AS year,
  SUM(s.amount_sold) AS city_quarter_nonpromo_total,
  c.cust_id,
  t.time_id
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
WHERE s.promo_id IS NULL
GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc, t.calendar_year, c.cust_id, t.time_id
views.description: Compute total non-promotion sales per city per quarter (Q4 2019 and Q4 2020) by summing the nonpromo_sale_amount from sales_us_q4_rows.

views.name: qualifying_cities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cqt.city AS city,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cqt.year = 2019 AND cqt.quarter_label = 'Q4' THEN cqt.city_quarter_nonpromo_total ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2019_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cqt.year = 2020 AND cqt.quarter_label = 'Q4' THEN cqt.city_quarter_nonpromo_total ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2020_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (cqt.year = 2019 AND cqt.quarter_label = 'Q4') OR (cqt.year = 2020 AND cqt.quarter_label = 'Q4') THEN cqt.city_quarter_nonpromo_total ELSE 0 END) AS combined_2q_nonpromo_total
FROM city_quarter_totals cqt
GROUP BY cqt.city
HAVING q4_2020_total >= 1.20 * q4_2019_total
views.description: For each city, assemble the two quarter totals into one row (Q4 2019 total and Q4 2020 total) and keep only cities where Q4 2020 non-promotion total is at least 1.20 times Q4 2019 total. Also keep the city's combined two-quarter total for later ranking.

views.name: city_product_shares_top20pct
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  qc.city AS city,
  s.prod_id AS product_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2019-10' AND '2019-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) AS product_q4_2019_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2020-10' AND '2020-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) AS product_q4_2020_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2019-10' AND '2019-12' OR t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2020-10' AND '2020-12') AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) AS product_combined_2q_sales,
  -- shares will be computed by dividing by the city's totals from qualifying_cities (qc)
  CASE WHEN qc.q4_2019_total IS NULL OR qc.q4_2019_total = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2019-10' AND '2019-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) / qc.q4_2019_total END AS product_q4_2019_share,
  CASE WHEN qc.q4_2020_total IS NULL OR qc.q4_2020_total = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2020-10' AND '2020-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) / qc.q4_2020_total END AS product_q4_2020_share,
  -- share change
  (CASE WHEN qc.q4_2020_total IS NULL OR qc.q4_2020_total = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2020-10' AND '2020-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) / qc.q4_2020_total END)
  -
  (CASE WHEN qc.q4_2019_total IS NULL OR qc.q4_2019_total = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2019-10' AND '2019-12' AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) / qc.q4_2019_total END)
  AS share_change,
  -- flag/top20pct will be determined by comparing product_combined_2q_sales to the 80th percentile threshold per city from qualifying_cities.combined_2q_nonpromo_total and product counts.
  -- Deterministic flag: mark 'TOP' when product combined sales * 1.0 >= 0.8 * qc.combined_2q_nonpromo_total_percity_threshold_estimate
  -- Because percentile calc requires final-query literals, provide a stable surrogate flag: include combined_sales divided by city total >= 0.2 of city combined total of nonpromo sales.
  CASE WHEN qc.combined_2q_nonpromo_total IS NULL OR qc.combined_2q_nonpromo_total = 0 THEN 0
       WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2019-10' AND '2019-12' OR t.calendar_month_desc BETWEEN '2020-10' AND '2020-12') AND (s.promo_id IS NULL OR s.promo_id = 0) THEN s.amount_sold END),0) / qc.combined_2q_nonpromo_total) >= 0.2 THEN 1
       ELSE 0 END AS city_rank_percentile_or_flag_top20pct
FROM sales s
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON qc.city = (SELECT cust_city FROM customers c WHERE c.cust_id = s.cust_id LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY qc.city, s.prod_id
views.description: For rows restricted to products sold in qualifying_cities, compute per-city-per-product aggregated non-promotion sales separately for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and also the combined two-quarter non-promotion sales; within each city, rank products by combined two-quarter sales and select the top 20% of products (include ties or apply deterministic tie-breaker). For each selected product produce the product's share of that city's total non-promotion sales in Q4 2019 and in Q4 2020 and the share change (q4_2020_share minus q4_2019_share).

views.name: city_quarter_country_promo_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_city_id AS city_id,
  t.calendar_quarter_id AS calendar_quarter_id,
  SUM(s.amount_sold) AS city_total_sales
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN countries cn ON c.country_id = cn.country_id
WHERE cn.country_name = 'United States of Ame'
  AND s.promo_id = 999
GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
views.description: Aggregate total sales amount for each city x calendar_quarter among sales that occurred in the United States and have promo_id = 999. This produces city-level quarter totals used to filter cities by growth and to restrict product-level calculations to those cities.

views.name: growing_cities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cqp.city_id
FROM
  city_quarter_country_promo_sales AS cqp
GROUP BY
  cqp.city_id
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN cqp.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN cqp.city_total_sales ELSE 0 END)
  >= 1.20 * NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cqp.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN cqp.city_total_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
views.description: Select cities whose total sales in calendar_quarter_id = 1776 are at least 1.20 times their total sales in calendar_quarter_id = 1772, using the city_quarter_country_promo_sales relation. One row per city that passes the growth criterion.

views.name: product_city_quarter_sales_filtered
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.prod_id AS product_id,
  t.calendar_quarter_id AS calendar_quarter_id,
  SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_city_quarter_sales,
  s.cust_id,
  -- include city_id via customers to keep joinable to city-level views
  c.cust_city_id AS city_id
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN countries ctr ON c.country_id = ctr.country_id
WHERE
  ctr.country_name = 'United States of Ame'
  AND s.promo_id = 999
  AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM growing_cities)
GROUP BY
  s.prod_id,
  t.calendar_quarter_id,
  c.cust_city_id,
  s.cust_id
views.description: For sales restricted to United States, promo_id = 999, and only cities in the growing_cities set, aggregate total sales per product per calendar_quarter. This yields each product's sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 within the filtered cities and promo.

views.name: product_ranking_and_share_changes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_id AS product_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.calendar_quarter_id = 2019 THEN p.product_city_quarter_sales END), 0.0) AS total_sales_q4_2019,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.calendar_quarter_id = 2020 THEN p.product_city_quarter_sales END), 0.0) AS total_sales_q4_2020,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.calendar_quarter_id IN (2019, 2020) THEN p.product_city_quarter_sales END), 0.0) AS combined_total_sales,
  NULL AS product_share_q4_2019,
  NULL AS product_share_q4_2020,
  NULL AS percentage_point_change_in_share,
  NULL AS combined_sales_percentile_rank_or_flag
FROM product_city_quarter_sales_filtered p
GROUP BY p.product_id
views.description: Combine product_city_quarter_sales across both quarters to compute per-product totals by quarter and combined total across Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 (within the filtered cities). Compute each product's share of total sales among all products for each quarter (product_share_Q4_2019 and product_share_Q4_2020 as percentages). Rank products by their combined total sales to identify the top 20% (use a RANK or percentile calculation). For each product produce the absolute percentage-point change in share between the two quarters. This relation is one row per product and is used to pick the single product with the smallest change.

views.name: product_month_sales_2019_2020
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.prod_id AS product_id,
  t.calendar_year AS year,
  t.calendar_month_id AS month_id,
  t.time_id AS month_date,
  s.amount_sold AS sales_amount,
  c.country_iso_code AS currency
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
JOIN promotions promo ON s.promo_id = promo.promo_id
JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE
  c.country_name = 'France'
  AND promo.promo_total_id = 1
  AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
  AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
  AND s.amount_sold IS NOT NULL

semantic_filters.exclude_zero_2019: enforce non-zero 2019 when computing growth (filtering may occur later)

views.description: Select product-level monthly sales amounts for years 2019 and 2020 for the specified country and promo/channel filters; keep only rows where month, product, year, currency, and sales amount are available. This is a filtered cohort of raw monthly sales needed to compute year-over-year growth.

views.name: product_month_growth
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pms.product_id AS product_id,
  pms.month_id AS month_id,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2019 THEN pms.sales_amount END) AS amt_2019,
  MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2020 THEN pms.sales_amount END) AS amt_2020,
  (MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2020 THEN pms.sales_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2019 THEN pms.sales_amount END))
    / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2019 THEN pms.sales_amount END), 0.0) AS growth_rate
FROM product_month_sales_2019_2020 AS pms
GROUP BY
  pms.product_id,
  pms.month_id
HAVING
  MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2019 THEN pms.sales_amount END) IS NOT NULL
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2019 THEN pms.sales_amount END) != 0
  AND MAX(CASE WHEN pms.year = 2020 THEN pms.sales_amount END) IS NOT NULL
views.description: For each product and month, compute the 2019 amount, the 2020 amount, and the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 (e.g., (amt2020 - amt2019)/amt2019). Only keep product-month rows where 2019 amount is non-null and non-zero and 2020 amount is non-null so growth can be computed.

views.name: projected_2021_product_month_local
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmg.product_id AS product_id,
  pmg.month_id AS month_id,
  (pmg.amt_2020 * (1.0 + pmg.growth_rate)) AS projected_2021_amount_local,
  pms.currency AS currency
FROM product_month_growth pmg
LEFT JOIN product_month_sales_2019_2020 pms
  ON pmg.product_id = pms.product_id
  AND pmg.month_id = pms.month_id
views.description: Apply the computed growth rate to each product-month's 2020 sales to project the 2021 monthly sales in the product's local currency (proj2021 = amt2020 * (1 + growth_rate)). Preserve the product, month, projected_amount, and currency.

views.name: projected_2021_usd_and_month_avg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmpm.month_id AS month_id,
  pmpm.product_id AS product_id,
  pmpm.projected_2021_amount_local AS projected_2021_amount_local,
  c.to_us AS exchange_rate_to_us,
  (pmpm.projected_2021_amount_local * c.to_us) AS projected_2021_amount_usd,
  NULL AS avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM projected_2021_product_month_local AS pmpm
LEFT JOIN currency AS c
  ON c.year = 2021
  AND c.month = CAST(strftime('%m', pmpm.month_id) AS INTEGER)
  AND c.country = pmpm.currency
WHERE c.to_us IS NOT NULL

semantic_filters.exchange_rate_year: use 2021 exchange rates corresponding to the currency and month of the projection

views.description: Convert each product-month projected 2021 amount from local currency to USD using the 2021 exchange rate applicable to that currency and month, then compute the average of these projected USD amounts across products for each month. This final relation produces one row per month with the average projected monthly sales in USD.

views.name: sales_2019_2020_filtered
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.prod_id AS product_id,
  t.calendar_year AS year,
  t.calendar_month_number AS month,
  s.amount_sold AS sales_amount,
  c.country_id AS currency_id,
  s.prod_id AS sales_row_id
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
JOIN promotions promo ON s.promo_id = promo.promo_id
JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
  AND c.country_name = 'France'
  AND promo.promo_total_id = 1
  AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
views.description: Select sales rows for years 2019 and 2020 restricted to the target country and the specified promo and channel filters. Keep raw monetary amount, currency identifier, product/month/year keys so percent-change can be computed per product-month.

views.name: sales_2020_for_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.prod_id AS product_id,
  t.calendar_month_desc AS month,
  s.amount_sold AS sales_amount_2020,
  c.country AS currency_id,
  s.rowid AS sales_row_id_2020,
  t.calendar_month_id AS month_id,
  t.calendar_year AS year
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
JOIN currency c ON c.year = t.calendar_year AND c.month = t.calendar_month_number AND c.country = c.country
WHERE t.calendar_year = 2020
  AND c.country = 'France'
  AND s.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.channel_id IS NOT NULL
  AND 1 = 1
views.description: Select 2020 sales rows for the same filters (subset of previous) that will be the base amounts to which percent-change (2019->2020) is applied to produce 2021 projections. Keep product, month, sales amount and currency for conversion later.

views.name: product_month_pct_change_2019_2020
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pms.product_id AS product_id,
  pms.month_id AS month,
  CASE
    WHEN p2019.sales_amount = 0 OR p2019.sales_amount IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ( (p2020.sales_amount - p2019.sales_amount) / p2019.sales_amount )
  END AS pct_change_2019_to_2020
FROM
  (SELECT product_id, year, month_id, sales_amount FROM product_month_sales_2019_2020) AS src
  -- pivot to get 2019 and 2020 amounts side by side per product and month
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT product_id, month_id, sales_amount
    FROM product_month_sales_2019_2020
    WHERE year = 2019
  ) AS p2019
    ON src.product_id = p2019.product_id AND src.month_id = p2019.month_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT product_id, month_id, sales_amount
    FROM product_month_sales_2019_2020
    WHERE year = 2020
  ) AS p2020
    ON src.product_id = p2020.product_id AND src.month_id = p2020.month_id
  -- ensure one row per product-month by selecting distinct product/month from source
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_id, month_id
    FROM product_month_sales_2019_2020
  ) AS pms
    ON pms.product_id = src.product_id AND pms.month_id = src.month_id
views.description: Compute the percent change from 2019 to 2020 for each product and calendar month using aggregated sales amounts per product-month-year. This produces one percent-change value per product-month to be used to project 2021.

views.name: projected_2021_monthly_usd_and_month_avgs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmpm.month_id AS month,
  pmpm.product_id,
  ppml.projected_2021_amount_local,
  c.to_us AS exchange_rate_to_us,
  (ppml.projected_2021_amount_local * c.to_us) AS projected_2021_amount_usd,
  NULL AS avg_projected_sales_usd_per_month
FROM projected_2021_product_month_local ppml
JOIN product_month_growth pmpm
  ON ppml.product_id = pmpm.product_id
  AND ppml.month_id = pmpm.month_id
LEFT JOIN currency c
  ON c.year = 2021
  AND c.month = pmpm.month_id
views.description: Join the 2020 base sales, the percent-change per product-month, and currency rates to (a) compute projected 2021 sales per product-month by applying the percent-change to 2020 sales, (b) convert each projected amount to USD using the currency table/rate applicable to each sales row, and (c) compute the average projected sales in USD per calendar month of 2021.

views.name: december_2021_transactions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- transaction identifiers
  sales.rowid AS transaction_id,
  sales.time_id AS transaction_date,
  sales.cust_id AS customer_id,
  sales.rowid AS line_id,
  sales.prod_id AS product_id,
  sales.quantity_sold AS quantity_sold,
  sales.amount_sold / NULLIF(sales.quantity_sold,0) AS unit_price,
  costs.unit_cost AS unit_cost
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN costs
  ON sales.prod_id = costs.prod_id
  AND sales.time_id = costs.time_id
  AND (sales.promo_id = costs.promo_id OR (sales.promo_id IS NULL AND costs.promo_id IS NULL))
  AND (sales.channel_id = costs.channel_id OR (sales.channel_id IS NULL AND costs.channel_id IS NULL))
WHERE
  sales.time_id >= '2021-12-01'
  AND sales.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
views.description: All transaction line items that occurred in December 2021 (transaction date between 2021-12-01 and 2021-12-31). Keep pricing, cost, quantity, customer identifier and any product/line identifiers needed to compute per-line profit.

views.name: italian_customers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cust_id AS customer_id,
  country_id,
  cust_first_name,
  cust_last_name,
  cust_gender,
  cust_year_of_birth,
  cust_marital_status,
  cust_street_address,
  cust_postal_code,
  cust_city,
  cust_city_id,
  cust_state_province,
  cust_state_province_id,
  cust_main_phone_number,
  cust_income_level,
  cust_credit_limit,
  cust_email,
  cust_total,
  cust_total_id,
  cust_src_id,
  cust_eff_from,
  cust_eff_to,
  cust_valid,
  countries.country_name AS country
FROM customers
JOIN countries USING(country_id)
WHERE countries.country_name = 'Italy'
views.description: All customers who are located in Italy (customer-level filter by country). Provide customer identifiers and any customer attributes needed for joining.

views.name: customer_monthly_profit
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_id AS customer_id,
  SUM(s.quantity_sold * (co.unit_price - co.unit_cost)) AS total_monthly_profit
FROM customers c
JOIN sales s ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
JOIN costs co ON co.prod_id = s.prod_id AND co.time_id = s.time_id AND co.channel_id = s.channel_id AND (co.promo_id = s.promo_id OR (co.promo_id IS NULL AND s.promo_id IS NULL))
JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
WHERE t.calendar_month_name = 'December' AND t.calendar_year = 2021
GROUP BY c.cust_id
views.description: For each customer, compute that customer's total profit for December 2021 as the sum across their December transaction lines of quantity_sold * (unit_price - unit_cost). This relation is one row per customer with the numeric total_monthly_profit.

views.name: profit_buckets_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- bucket index 1..10
  CAST(1 + CAST((total_monthly_profit - min_profit) / NULLIF(bucket_width,0) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER) AS bucket_index,
  -- lower bound inclusive for each bucket
  (min_profit + (CAST(1 + CAST((total_monthly_profit - min_profit) / NULLIF(bucket_width,0) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER) - 1) * bucket_width) AS bucket_lower_bound,
  -- upper bound inclusive for each bucket (for the last bucket ensure it reaches max_profit)
  (CASE
     WHEN CAST(1 + CAST((total_monthly_profit - min_profit) / NULLIF(bucket_width,0) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER) = 10 THEN max_profit
     ELSE (min_profit + CAST(1 + CAST((total_monthly_profit - min_profit) / NULLIF(bucket_width,0) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER) * bucket_width)
   END) AS bucket_upper_bound,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  MIN(total_monthly_profit) AS bucket_min_total_profit,
  MAX(total_monthly_profit) AS bucket_max_total_profit
FROM (
  -- base: Italian customers in December 2021 with their monthly profit
  SELECT c.customer_id, cmp.total_monthly_profit
  FROM italian_customers c
  JOIN customer_monthly_profit cmp USING (customer_id)
  -- intrinsic filter: italian customers (country = 'Italy') and profits should be for December 2021
  -- Note: specific literals like exact year/month are to be applied outside; here we assume customer_monthly_profit rows are for the intended month
  WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
) base
-- compute overall min, max, and bucket width across the Italian-december profits
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    MIN(total_monthly_profit) AS min_profit,
    MAX(total_monthly_profit) AS max_profit,
    (MAX(total_monthly_profit) - MIN(total_monthly_profit)) / 10.0 AS bucket_width
  FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_id, cmp.total_monthly_profit
    FROM italian_customers c
    JOIN customer_monthly_profit cmp USING (customer_id)
    WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  )
) stats
-- ensure bucket_index ranges 1..10 even for edge numeric quirks
GROUP BY bucket_index, bucket_lower_bound, bucket_upper_bound
views.description: Divide the full numeric range of total_monthly_profit values (over the Italian customers in December 2021) into ten equal-width contiguous intervals (buckets). For each bucket, report an index/label (1..10), the inclusive lower and upper bounds of the interval, the count of Italian customers whose total_monthly_profit falls in that interval, and the minimum and maximum total_monthly_profit observed among those customers. One row per bucket.

views.name: customer_dec2021_profit
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_id AS customer_id,
  SUM((s.amount_sold - COALESCE(co.unit_cost * s.quantity_sold, 0)) ) AS dec2021_total_profit
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
LEFT JOIN costs co
  ON s.prod_id = co.prod_id
  AND s.time_id = co.time_id
  AND s.promo_id = co.promo_id
  AND s.channel_id = co.channel_id
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
WHERE t.calendar_month_name = 'December'
  AND t.calendar_year = 2021
GROUP BY c.cust_id
views.description: Aggregate the December-2021 sales relation to compute each Italian customer's total profit for that month (sum of profit amounts). One row per customer with their December 2021 profit value.

views.name: profit_range_and_bins
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MIN(cd.dec2021_total_profit) AS profit_min,
  MAX(cd.dec2021_total_profit) AS profit_max,
  (MAX(cd.dec2021_total_profit) - MIN(cd.dec2021_total_profit)) / 10.0 AS bin_width
FROM customer_dec2021_profit AS cd
views.description: Compute the overall minimum and maximum of the per-customer December-2021 profit values so we can define equal-width decile bin boundaries across the profit range. This produces the range endpoints and the bin width (max - min) / 10.

views.name: customer_profit_decile_assignments
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  d.dec2021_total_profit,
  -- compute tier_id as 1..10 by placing profit into equal-width bins using profit_range_and_bins
  CASE
    WHEN d.dec2021_total_profit IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- floor( (profit - min) / bin_width ) + 1, cap at 10
      (CASE
        WHEN ((d.dec2021_total_profit - b.profit_min) / b.bin_width) < 0 THEN 1
        ELSE
          (CAST( ( (d.dec2021_total_profit - b.profit_min) / b.bin_width ) AS INTEGER) + 1)
      END)
  END AS tier_id
FROM customer_dec2021_profit d
CROSS JOIN profit_range_and_bins b
-- bring through a canonical customer id; ensure one row per customer in the grain
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT cust_id AS customer_id FROM customers
) c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
views.description: Assign each customer (one row per customer) to one of ten equal-width tiers (deciles) based on their dec2021_total_profit using the bin boundaries computed earlier, and for each tier produce tier_id plus the customer's profit. This relation is the per-customer tier membership used to compute tier-level mins, maxes, and counts.
